title: OblivoneSort
description: OblivoneSort is a C++17 header-only, unstable distribution sort. It maps values to order-preserving uint64 keys, computes bucket indices directly, counts, prefix-sums, scatters, and recursively sorts buckets. An optional public parallel phase-pool backend provides root count/scatter/copy and group sorting. The advanced work-stealing scheduler is experimental and excluded from install. It targets random and smooth numeric distributions, not TimSort-style structured data.
